title: Tailwise Pharmacy Terms of Service: Shipping on One-Time Pharmacy Orders
content:
## Section 1. Assessment basis

1.1 Shipping on one-time Tailwise Pharmacy orders is assessed per customer and per dispense date, across all of that customer's one-time pharmacy fills dispensed on that date, whichever prescriptions and classes they belong to.

1.2 The same-day subtotal is the sum of the merchandise subtotals of the customer's one-time-order fills dispensed on that date.

## Section 2. Standard shipping fee

2.1 When the same-day subtotal is at least the free-shipping threshold of every class shipped that day, no standard shipping fee is charged.

2.2 Otherwise one standard pharmacy shipping fee is charged — the highest among the classes shipped that day — on the fill with the largest merchandise subtotal, and 0.00 is charged on the others.

2.3 A customer whose Tailwise Plus membership is in status active pays no standard shipping fee on pharmacy orders.

2.4 Autoship fills follow the Autoship shipping rules and are never assessed under these terms.

## Section 3. Adult-signature fee

3.1 Where a class requires an adult signature on delivery, its adult-signature fee is charged once per shipment containing such a fill.

3.2 The adult-signature fee is never waived by the free-shipping threshold or by membership.

The class figures for the fee, the threshold, the signature requirement and the signature fee are those of the Tailwise Pharmacy class schedule for shipping.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical fills, class figures from the shipping schedule)

- One customer, one dispense date: an Rx Maintenance Medication fill with a $30.00 subtotal and an Rx Prescription Diet fill with a $15.00 subtotal, both one-time orders, no active Tailwise Plus membership. Same-day subtotal $45.00, below the $49.00 threshold of both classes. One fee of $4.95 is charged on the $30.00 fill and 0.00 on the $15.00 fill.
- Same date, an Rx Preventive fill of $40.00 and an Rx Compounded Medication fill of $20.00. Same-day subtotal $60.00 meets the Rx Preventive threshold but not the $99.00 Rx Compounded Medication threshold, so the fee is not waived. The highest fee among the classes shipped, $9.95, is charged on the $40.00 fill.
- A one-time Rx Controlled Substance fill of $80.00 for a customer with an active Tailwise Plus membership: no standard shipping fee (Section 2.3), but the $5.50 adult-signature fee is charged once on that shipment (Section 3.2).
